description:
The official marine forecast bulletin for the maritime zone containing a
    point — the text a national weather service publishes for mariners, not a
    model output.

    Providers, matched automatically to the point: Météo-France (BMR coastal),
    AEMET (Spain), MeteoAM (Italy), Met Office (UK inshore waters and shipping
    forecast). Pass `provider` to force one of `mf`, `aemet`, `meteoam`,
    `metoffice`.

    The bulletin is returned in the language its issuing service publishes it in
    (see `language`). Quote it, do not translate it as if it were the official
    wording.

    Costs no third-party call when warm: bulletins are cached 1-3 hours.
name: get_marine_bulletin
title: Official marine bulletin
